scope.summary: Every SQL path goes through the read executor with type-level provenance (#53 sample_rows): catalog query registry, privileged-path reclassification at apply, arch-fitness seam lint (1cc68e57), and a registry test that dispatches every runtime tool through the real dispatcher (e87ec6a1).

The rework dispatches every name in tool_names() through OracleDispatcher against ProvenanceCheckingConn, fails on any untagged SQL and on a read/catalog route issuing no tagged query, and a planted raw query_rows route is rejected by the same validator.
